# Insert features fixture

`insert-features.docx` is written by `make_fixture.py` from hand-written WordprocessingML, without
the editor's engine, so the Insert tab's reader paths are checked against a package this editor did not
produce. It holds a drop cap frame, DATE and DOCPROPERTY fields, an inline equation, an SVG picture with
a PNG fallback, a grouped diagram with shape text and a diagram description, a column chart part with
literal data, a WordArt text box with an ignorable w14 outline and section page numbering. The PNG is
generated by the script; the SVG is a two-stroke drawing written for it. License: same as this repository.
Regenerate with `python3 make_fixture.py` (Python standard library only).
